name: gizza-ai/add-text-to-image
summary: Overlay caption/watermark text on an image.

tool.description: Overlay custom text (a caption, watermark, or meme line) onto an image and return a PNG. Set x/y for the top-left text position in pixels, font_size in pixels, and color as #rrggbb. Use \n in text for multiple lines. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior image tool call).

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

text.description: The text to overlay (use \n for multiple lines).

x.description: Left position of the text in pixels (default 10).

y.description: Top position of the text in pixels (default 10).
